Performance Marketing FAQs

Questions About Google Ads, Meta Ads and PPC Campaigns

What is performance marketing?

Performance marketing is a digital advertising approach where campaigns are planned, measured and optimised around actions such as clicks, leads, calls, enquiries, sales and conversions.

Does DGS manage Google Ads?

Yes. DGS manages Google Search Ads, Performance Max campaigns, remarketing campaigns and PPC campaign optimisation for businesses that want measurable enquiries.

Does DGS run Meta Ads?

Yes. DGS runs Meta Ads across Facebook and Instagram for lead generation, brand awareness, remarketing, creative testing and conversion campaigns.

What makes a campaign successful?

A campaign performs better when targeting, creative, landing page experience, conversion tracking, budget allocation and remarketing work together.
